name: Lotte Innovate Co Ltd
summary: Lotte Innovate Co., Ltd. primarily delivers services in system management (SM), system integration (SI), and electric vehicle (EV) charging. The company also offers an extensive array of information technology (IT) solutions, encompassing IT outsourcing, IT infrastructure diagnostics, the establishment of service level agreements (SLAs) and management systems, and security assessments. Furthermore, its capabilities include developing custom systems, creating software based on existing packages, providing continuous system management, operational support and maintenance, data center facilities, and network services. Founded on November 2, 2017, the organization is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
